result.sql:
WITH step_s1 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.geom AS geom, NULL::double precision AS value, f.name::text AS name, f.city::text AS city, f.state::text AS state, NULL::text AS county, f.address::text AS address, NULL::text AS type, NULL::text AS status FROM d968f276355a41d1bd1451be6ee4dbac_fire_stations f WHERE f.city ILIKE $1),
     step_s2 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.geom AS geom, NULL::double precision AS value, f.name::text AS name, f.city::text AS city, f.state::text AS state, NULL::text AS county, f.address::text AS address, NULL::text AS type, NULL::text AS status FROM d968f276355a41d1bd1451be6ee4dbac_fire_stations f),
     step_s3 AS (SELECT a.geom, d.m / 1609.344 AS value, a.name, a.city, a.state, a.county, a.address, a.type, a.status FROM step_s2 a CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(ST_Distance(a.geom::geography, b.geom::geography)) AS m FROM step_s1 b WHERE b.geom && ST_Expand(a.geom, ($2::float8) / 110574.0 / cos(radians(least(greatest(abs(ST_YMin(a.geom)), abs(ST_YMax(a.geom))) + ($2::float8) / 110574.0, 89.9))), ($2::float8) / 110574.0) AND ST_DWithin(a.geom::geography, b.geom::geography, $2)) d WHERE d.m IS NOT NULL)
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(r.geom) AS geometry, r.value AS miles_to_nearest, r.name, r.city, r.state, r.address
FROM step_s3 r
ORDER BY r.value ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3000
